notes: Formal comparative enrollment opens after P24 freeze. Do not pool P04 Path A alpha outcomes into this ledger. Synthetic sessions never count toward host-time or intake gates.

field_definitions.host_active_minutes: Checking, correction, and troubleshooting inclusive — not generate-click only
field_definitions.founder_support_minutes: Separate from host time; includes fact maintenance
field_definitions.intake_completed_without_researcher: boolean; researcher-entered rows fail the intake gate
field_definitions.predicted_preference: ordinal/shortlist position or null; never imputed
field_definitions.actual_venue_used: venue id/name or null if outing did not happen; never imputed from intention
field_definitions.abandoned: true if session stopped before export or explicit abandon
